10 years ago, rescue team leader Zhang suffered the loss of his son in a landslide during a typhoon. His anguish leads to his wifes request for divorce. While Zhang tries to reconcile with his family, another typhoon strikes. His wife is trapped and their daughter is kidnapped. Facing such difficulties, Zhang must save his wife and daughter.

During the Qing Dynasty, two magistrates died from a deadly snake bite, causing fear amongst the people. When two imperial constables investigate the case, they discover that a Happiness drug is commonly abused in town. Despite facing many difficulties during the investigation, they strive to bring the mastermind to justice.

In an AI-driven world, the underground institute has developed chips which can activate supernatural power for profiteering. An accident occurs and killed Qian Hes mother. Qian He vows to avenge her mothers death and fight against the villains after provoking her supernatural power, finally unveiling the institutes hidden secret.

p.t: Monkey King: The One and Only
p.d: Monkey King clashes with Monk Tang on their quest for Buddhist Sutras as Tang suspects Monkey of taking lives. One day, they meet Foxy Seven, whose brother plans to eat Monk Tang to save his life. Foxy Sevens brother stirs up conflicts between Monk and Monkey, but through trials and tribulations, they reconcile and continue their journey.

Policeman Wang hates crime in the city and the feudalism that lead to his sons death by opium. Disguised as a Taoist priest, he investigates opium smuggling in a merchants home and uncovers a series of murders. Driven by duty and revenge, Wang vows to find the murderer, destroy the stored opium and restore peace in the city.

Emperor Zhou Wu has defeated the Shang empire with General Yang defeating the Shang army. Military advisor Shen advises Emperor Shang to recruit Seven Monsters with mystic skills to attack Zhou, so Emperor Shang orders his general to find Seven Monsters in Mountain Mei. The battle between Zhou and Shang has just begun!

Young Huo Yuan Jia loves marital arts. He defeats seven martial arts school masters to establish himself in Tianjin, but is set up by a court official during a tournament. When Huo escorts a revolutionary leader to the capital, he finally understands that the country and its people are the ultimate purpose for practising martial arts.

The Tiger Team of Storm Security Company is assigned by the International Peace Foundation to escort a truck filled with water purifiers and planting seeds to Sakiya village. Despite an anarchist attack, the team strives to overcome the fierce battle so that the supplies can be delivered to the villagers successfully.

Asias biggest human trafficker Ba Song, invites the triad bosses to attend his private party. Ya Mei sneaks in and helps her teammates to escape by setting off a bomb, at the same time faking the death of herself and her fiancée. Three years later, Mei must resume duty to fight against Ba Song in order to save her kidnapped fiancée.

Huo, a famous university botany professor, uses animal and plant DNAs to develop a virus. His assistant, Cheng, falls in love with his student, Ke, but Ke gets infected during a sudden virus outbreak in the university. To save Ke and the university, Cheng stumbles upon the professors secret laboratory and unveils a secret between Huo and Ke.

In the Southern Song era, a young master and staff at Fei Yun inn aid General Li Xian Zhong to recover the lost territory in a northern expedition. However, Deputy General Shaos jealousy and sabotage cause the mission to fail. Fueled by anger, the team vows to capture Shao while helping the civilians to evacuate.

Motivated by his father, a retired athlete helps the female soccer team to win the game and ease the plight of the school. This inspirational story showcases the effort by people to achieve a better life while working hard at relationships with family members, lovers, teachers and students.

Tasked with absolving Wus wrongful conviction, Song Ci races against time to unveil the real culprit within two days. With the enigmatic clues on a paper fan and a missing weapon, Song Ci draws closer to finding the culprit. However, an indictment hiding a conspiracy suddenly appears, leaving Song Ci speechless...

In the Chen Dynasty, Chen Ling is assigned to investigate a supernatural case in Wu Xiang City. There, a man who pretends to help Chen Ling wants to steal a supernatural plant whose poison will cause people to bite each other, so as to take revenge on Chen and the master who killed his tribe. A fierce battle has just begun!

Returning to early 20th-century Shanghai to marry his fiancée, Chen Zhen discovers his revered martial arts master has died mysteriously. He launches a relentless quest for vengeance against the rival Japanese dojo responsible.

p.d: After moving into a house with her boyfriend, Gun, architect May learns of her stepmother’s mysterious death. When May takes in her stepsister Noon, the girl begins showing signs of possession, while May suffers disturbing visions and insomnia. As dark secrets emerge, spiritual masters uncover an ancient black-magic curse hidden within the house.

A single-parent family (Yu Xiang and Tong Tong) moves into a new neighbourhood where everyone’s life seems perfect. However, while things may look rosy on the outside, dark secrets and horror raid each family from the inside, and nothing really are as they seem.

Haunted since childhood, orphan Azlinda believes her torment stems from her parents dark history. Her friends Zurina, Wati, and Ustaz join forces to end her suffering, but a malevolent demon interrupts their efforts. Will Azlinda succeed in severing the cursed ties that bind her, or is she destined to remain trapped in darkness forever?

After their young daughter’s mysterious disappearance, Drew and Helen retreat to a secluded woodland cottage for therapy. As they struggle to salvage their marriage, isolation fractures their sanity. Haunted by visions and strange events, Helen can no longer tell what is real as her mind unravels.

Scholar Wang Huai Qing sells paintings to save his ailing wife. He is attacked by a bird demon along the way but is rescued by Fox demon Xiao Rong. To elude the pursuit, Wang brings Xiao Rong home, sparking a love triangle and at the same time, unfolding an impending love between human and demon.

In a coastal town, a forbidden romance sparks between Rico and Sisca, and their love unleashes a malevolent spirit. As chilling deaths plague the town, past secrets are being unraveled and the town is possessed by evil and fear. Rico must defy destiny and fight against the evil spirit to save his loved one.

Ghost Hand and his tomb raiders resurface in Jiang City to seek gold in ancient tombs after a 3-year absence. They released an evil spirit from a coffin and all four died at home eventually. Poison and pinholes in the corpses become the sole clue for police investigation. A tomb raid now unfolds as a perplexing and mysterious case.

A reporter hears three horror stories when investigating a case of the paper doll spirit 20 years ago. Miss Qiao had died in vain then, and her butler paid a paper craftsman to make a paper doll to be buried with her. Miss Qiao’s spirit is revived to take revenge when the doll’s eyes are drawn, and a series of horrible events begins to happen...
